subject: Density Not Plotted At Ends Past Crossover Point

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Density Not Plotted At Ends Past Crossover Point
parts:
When I plot two densities with stat_density, one of the densities isn't shown further than the place where they cross over. As you can see from the stripchart, there is no data below 10 for the poor density. I have ggplot2 0.9.3.1.99.

densPlot <- ggplot(plotData, aes(x = expr, colour = groups)) + stat_density(aes(y = ..density..), geom = "path", size = 1, adjust = 0.5) + scale_colour_manual("Vital", values = c("red", "blue")) + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank()) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(5, 16))
stripPlot <- ggplot(plotData, aes(x = groups, y = expr)) + geom_dotplot(dotsize = 0.5, binaxis = "y", stackdir = "center", position = "dodge", aes(colour = groups)) + scale_colour_manual("Vital", values = c("red", "blue")) + ylab(expression(log[2](expression))) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(5, 16)) + coord_flip()
    grid.arrange(densPlot, stripPlot, nrow = 2, main = textGrob(rownames(expression)[geneRow], gp = gpar(fontsize = 18)))

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Re: Density Not Plotted At Ends Past Crossover Point
parts: This is a misunderstanding by me. As pointed out in another thread, position = "identity" should be given to stat_density, if the typical density plot is desired.
